newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers dip, rest of Europe stable, market thin.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers dip, rest of Europe stable, market thin.

text.p: ARA bunkers dipped on Monday, while prices in the rest of Europe were stable as buyers continued to delay their purchases, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST dipped by about $2 to $104/$105 fob. Traders said buyers remained convinced that prices would fall further in the near future and decided to stand on the sidelines. One supplier said enquiries totalled below 5,000 tonnes.
Sellers were keen to shed material they had already bought in the barge market. Their reluctance to buy anymore created a standstill.
"It was a bit more active this afternoon, but it's so low that it's almost impossible to keep trading," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices were little changed from Friday's close. The market was also quiet.
Mediterranean bunkers were also broadly stable and the market was thin in all ports.
"There's nothing at all. They (buyers) are all waiting," said one supplier typical of many.
Fujairah fuel oil bunkers dipped by $1/$2 to below the $100 mark.
